name: Canary Mail
soft_passes: #1 white ground fills a rounded-rect reading as the system squircle; exact superellipse match unverifiable at 204px
#2 optically centred but glyph mass sits slightly low-and-right (right-fanning darts pull weight)
#3 clean distinctive silhouette with a clear crescent anchor, but abstract — names as 'the Canary mark', not a concrete metaphor, and does not communicate 'email'
#5 reads as one top-gloss light, but the gel treatment multiplies speculars per shape
#8 depth coherent but built from baked shadow/gloss HIG would have the system generate
failures: #9 era coherence — Big-Sur white-squircle base wearing web-2.0 aqua-gel gloss whose light model belongs to neither the Big Sur nor Liquid Glass era
#10 variant robustness — single baked flat PNG, blue glyph depends on the white ground; no layered light/dark/clear/tinted authoring, won't survive tint or dark mode
light_model: baked glossy gel: top-lit specular sweep plus internal light-top-to-dark-bottom gradient per shape, over a soft baked drop shadow of the glyph on the white ground; not Big Sur matte, not system Liquid Glass
layer_stack: baked soft drop shadow of glyph
devices: crescent-C-plus-twin-darts logomark (Canary bird / send motif, doubles as a C monogram)
aqua-gel baked gloss with specular sweep
rhymes_hint: glossy brand-logomark-on-white-squircle tiles (aqua / web-2.0 gel family, common on cross-platform / Electron productivity apps); structurally adjacent to the Big-Sur coloured-glyph-on-white family but distinguished by baked gloss and background-dependence
notes: 204x204 web render from macapp.supply, upsampled to inspect — hexes from the native source are reliable, but edge geometry, exact squircle radius and sub-pixel gloss are soft estimates; not the 1024 master. Baked gloss + baked drop shadow contradict current HIG (system should apply effects) and there is no Icon Composer layer authoring, so no dark/clear/tinted variant would generate. Subject-communication gap: an email client whose icon shows a brand logomark with no mail/envelope/@ metaphor. Strong icon-to-app palette coherence: glyph blue (#2166EC-#68D6F8) matches the cover's cyan brand field (~#7FD4FF). Era is 'custom' rather than big-sur because the base and glyph light models come from different eras.
